div.div:
Key database constraints
User / Employee: unique email and unique LOWER(email). CompanyProfile: at most one active profile.
EmployeeWorkHours: unique (employee, work_date); 0 < hours <= 24.
CheatSheetStep: unique (cheatsheet, step_number).
